clips.title: Quest text
paras: Damn trolls! They've been killing off our agents in the jungle! I've already lost a good number of my best guards to skirmishes with them. The costs are piling up! How will I explain this to Baron Revilgaz?
Decisive action... Think, Kebok... You weren't assigned to the post you have today for sitting around... I've got it! You... Friend, is it? You'll help me, won't you? There's money to be had!
Here's the deal... You bring me the ears of fifteen Bloodscalp Trolls, and I'll compensate you well.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
